title: larix olgensis var. koreana
intro: Larix olgensis var. koreana, commonly known as the Korean larch, is a deciduous coniferous tree species native to Korea. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Larix olgensis var. koreana include its ability to act as an immunomodulator and an antiviral agent, making it useful in the treatment of various infections and immune system disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
